fact: Executive decree 23-169 of 24 April 2023 (JO n° 29 of 2 May 2023) sets the electronic company-creation portal run by the CNRC with tax, CASNOS, CNAS and ONS; one registration yields tax, statistical and social security numbers and a common identifier.
title: Création d'entreprise : toutes les formalités administratives se feront de manière électronique
